name: okf-agent-memory
description: A small command-line tool and MCP server that keeps project knowledge as a folder of Markdown notes in the Open Knowledge Format, searches it locally, and sets up an AGENTS.md that tells agents to search before writing.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI plus MCP server (single Go binary)

offline_no_account.value: Yes: local search, no database, no API key needed

plain_files.value: Yes: Markdown notes in a knowledge/ folder, tracked by git

footprint.value: Tiny: one small binary, no service or database

claude_code.value: Yes: MCP server and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md setup

windows.value: Native: windows-amd64 and arm64 binaries released

survives_compaction.value: Notes stay searchable on demand; compaction not mentioned

undo_delete.value: Git history; no separate undo command described

service_failure.value: No background service; runs per command
